source.title: Vector bundles and submanifolds of projective space: Nine open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 4061382. Local resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-1.csv identified the exact work as "Vector bundles and submanifolds of projective space: Nine open problems" from 1987.

failure_mode=network_or_dns_failure. Local Bash fetches of https://zbmath.org/4061382, https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/4061382, and https://api.zbmath.org/v1/documents/?q=4061382 failed with DNS resolution errors in the sandbox, so browser/search recovery and local resolver metadata were used only for identity recovery.
evidence_refs: curl: Could not resolve host: zbmath.org
curl: Could not resolve host: api.zbmath.org

trace.notes: failure_mode=metadata_only. Search recovery identified the AMS volume page for Algebraic Geometry--Bowdoin 1985, Part 2, listing Michael Schneider's article and MR 927976, but the accessible page exposed table-of-contents and bibliographic metadata rather than the article body containing the nine problem statements.

failure_mode=missing_or_invalid_artifact. Search recovery exposed a full-volume PDF candidate at digitale-objekte.hbz-nrw.de whose snippets showed the target article in the table of contents, but the PDF could not be opened through the available browser fetch, and local shell download was unavailable because DNS resolution is blocked in this sandbox.

failure_mode=ambiguous_resolution. Exact-work searches also surfaced secondary references, a later Schneider problem-list article from 1990, and unrelated pages sharing the numeric identifier 4061382. These candidates were rejected because they were not the same exact source or did not contain the readable 1987 article text.
No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article body was recovered, so document mapping and candidate extraction were not performed.

No accepted questions were produced because the source could not be normalized to a readable primary artifact. Resolver metadata, table-of-contents pages, secondary citations, search snippets, and different works were rejected under the source adequacy and no-new-facts gates.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath_4061382.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
